Key features: black sooty patches distributed across the leaf surface — this pattern is most consistent with Sooty_Mould. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference Sooty_Mould image is a strong match: scattered black sooty patches on a green leaf surface, identical distribution pattern and texture to the test image. The black encrustations on the leaf surface match the symptom description of superficial dark fungal mycelium growing on honeydew secretions.

This is not Anthracnose (which shows sunken brown lesions with red halos), not Powdery_Mildew (white powdery coating), and not Die_Back (bark darkening, twig withering).
